metadata.case_name: TAI KUT SING v. CHOI CHUN KWAN

source: the skin around the plaintiff's anal canal to corrode leading to necrosis of the skin tissues which led to his having a right anal stricture
injuries.icd_description: Injury of other specified pelvic organs

injuries.description: 2cm x 3cm cut wound at "6 o'clock of anal verge with active oozing."
source: Dr Lai, who examined him, found that there was a 2cm x 3cm cut wound at "6 o'clock of anal verge with active oozing."
injuries.icd_description: Laceration without foreign body of abdomen, lower back or pelvis

injuries.description: severe chemical burn or surgical excision or both
source: the plaintiff's right anal stricture was caused by a severe chemical burn or surgical excision or both
injuries.icd_description: Injury of other specified pelvic organs

injuries.description: permanently lost 40% of his anal function
source: the plaintiff has regained 60% of his anal function but he has permanently lost 40% of his anal function

manifestations.description: partial incontinence (leakage) of stool from time to time
able to pass stool reasonably comfortably but has partial incontinence
unable to sit for a long time without discomfort
needed to wash himself each time he has a bowel movement because he could not properly clean himself using only toilet paper

treatments_received: medical treatment at Princes Margaret Hospital
anoplasty (translocating skin from the plaintiff's buttock area to the anal canal)

losses.description: the plaintiff has permanently lost 40% of his anal function
his relationship with his wife was affected by his incontinence and about a year after the incident he separated from his wife and they are now divorced
he is a taxi driver but he can only now work at 75% capacity because he has to use the rest of the time for his toilet breaks

losses.category: Loss of holidays or special occasions
losses.description: due to his incontinence he could no longer join group tours for holidays abroad
